recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the approved removal-and-extension model and avoids sending implementers to extension canonicals that do not exist.
issue_request: FHIR-48924 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core FMG approval for creating Device maintenance extensions proposed by FHIR-47323, covering Device elements moved out of core by FHIR-32565.
initial_application: Core commit 9d3783acc0 commented out Device.mode, Device.cycle, and Device.duration in source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml. Extension-pack commit 8b6b7b0 created DeviceOperationMode, DeviceOperationCycle, and DeviceOperationDuration as device-operation-mode, device-operation-cycle, and device-operation-duration.
additional_context: FHIR-32565 approved moving Device.mode, Device.cycle, Device.duration, Device.gateway, and Device.endpoint out of core Device. FHIR-47323 implemented the maintenance operation extensions in the FHIR Extension Pack. Device is active in source/fhir.ini, and later Device introduction text referenced non-existent device-mode, device-cycle, and device-duration ids.
reconciliation: Updated source/device/device-introduction.xml to reference device-operation-mode, device-operation-cycle, and device-operation-duration. Gateway and endpoint references were already aligned and were not changed.
source_changes: source/device/device-introduction.xml: corrected the Device ballot note's maintenance extension names from device-mode/device-cycle/device-duration to device-operation-mode/device-operation-cycle/device-operation-duration.
